ip_rights._comment: IP rights tiers based on common hackathon organizer patterns

builder_friendly.description: Builder retains full IP. Organizer gets demo/showcase rights only.

limited_license.description: Builder retains IP but grants organizer non-exclusive license to use/promote.

broad_license.description: Organizer gets broad license (commercial use, derivative works). Builder retains ownership.

copyright_transfer.description: Builder assigns copyright to organizer. May retain limited rights.

work_for_hire.description: Treated as work-for-hire. Organizer owns everything.

agents_should_know: Always read the official rules before entering
IP terms may differ by track within the same hackathon
Some organizers retain IP but grant open-source licenses
Corporate sponsors sometimes have separate IP terms for their tracks
MVP/prototype vs production code may have different treatment
